name: Synology
description: Shows a Synology NAS (DiskStation Manager 7) as a host with its Container Manager containers, Virtual Machine Manager machines and installed packages as guests, matched to your network devices by IP or MAC. Read-only, over the DSM web API with HTTPS; needs a dedicated administrator account (DSM has no read-only API role). Tested on a virtual DSM 7.2.2 with Container Manager 24; Virtual Machine Manager and a DS923+ are still untested.
author: Netlens
supports: Synology DSM 7.2.2 (tested on a virtual DSM with Container Manager 24.0.2; containers, ports, packages)

releases.changelog: Tested against a real DSM 7.2.2. The container list of DSM has no ports or networks, so the plugin now reads them per container (docker inspect): published ports (also for stopped containers) and the address of a container on a macvlan network. Needs Netlens 0.3.157 or newer.
Run diagnostic no longer puts server addresses (host:port, IP addresses, host names) into the report. Nothing else changed.
First release. Containers, virtual machines and packages of a Synology NAS as guests of the NAS. Needs Netlens 0.3.157 or newer.
